title: Citrusy French Beef Pilaf
description: A flavorful beef pilaf dish infused with citrusy notes from the zingy citrus sauce. This dish is perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: French Pilaf Mix
ingredients.notes: follow package instructions for ratio of mix to liquid

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the pilaf mix and water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the pilaf is tender.
Stir in the zingy citrus sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and toss to combine with the pilaf and citrus sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
